parameter.name: decryptionConfigKey
parameter.description: Fallback only. Our private key store normally arrives as configKey on the stage.

parameter.name: verificationConfigKey
parameter.description: Name of the PGP Public Key connection holding the sender's key. Without it there is nothing to check the signature against.

parameter.name: passphrase
parameter.description: Overrides the passphrase held by the connection. Use a secure expression.

parameter.name: mode
parameter.description: strict (default) holds the message until its signature has been checked. streaming serves as it goes, and is safe only where a failed run undoes everything below this stage.

parameter.name: maxPlaintextSize
parameter.description: Cap on the plaintext held in strict mode, e.g. 50GB. A small OpenPGP message can decompress to an enormous one, and in strict mode it lands on this node's disk before it has been verified. Free space on the scratch volume is always enforced as well.

parameter.name: requireIntegrity
parameter.description: true (default) refuses a message that carries no modification detection code.

parameter.name: requireValidSignerKey
parameter.description: true (default) refuses a signature made with a revoked or expired key, even when the signature itself is valid.
